states: Matched production-mode Chromium 141.0.7390.37 / Playwright 1.56.1 previews, desktop light and touch phone dark. 302 fixture assertions and 408 asset/manifest checks; all 24 retained captures inspected.

Administrator before change and after hiding/showing. Guidance distinguishes form visibility from password authentication, says to verify SSO separately and keep a working local admin login, and shows how to reveal the form without resetting credentials. Confirmations both name the form.
Read-only and deployment-locked states keep disabled switches, their saved states and unchanged credential controls. New guidance fits with footer and navigation visible.
The exact reveal parameter stays together on a narrow screen.
Fresh signed-out contexts with and without a listed SSO provider: hidden password form is absent by default, unchanged reveal shows an empty form and never signs in.
interactions: Use Space on the focused desktop switch and tap on touch phone. Each change makes one synthetic POST of only hideLocalLogin, reads the resulting flag and displays the matching toast.
Navigate to the documented URL in a separate signed-out context. No submissions to identity providers or password endpoints, no signed-in session change and no live server operations.
